name: faithful-sampler reshoot sweep
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cd ~/bonsai2/asm && export OMP_NUM_THREADS=20 && for S in 51 52; do echo "### 27B-ZH seed $S"; taskset -c 0-19 ./fwd_mt ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 248045 846 198 99270 115992 104647 3709 98404 98443 96681 96594 110476 127312 1710 248046 198 248045 74455 198 248068 --gen 280 --sample 0.5 0.85 20 $S 0.05 2>/dev/null | grep "^step" | awk "NR>20" | sed "s/.*top=//;s/ .*//" | tr "
" " " > /tmp/z27_s$S.txt; echo; wc -w < /tmp/z27_s$S.txt; done; for S in 51 52; do echo "### 8B-EN seed $S"; taskset -c 3 ./fwd8 ../models/bonsai8b-PQ2_0.gguf 151644 872 198 852 279 3040 15584 323 825 3166 429 4344 304 1817 13 151645 198 151644 77091 198 151667 271 151668 --gen 150 --sample 0.6 0.95 20 $S 0.05 2>/dev/null | grep "^step" | awk "NR>23" | sed "s/.*top=//;s/ .*//" | tr "
" " " > /tmp/z8en_s$S.txt; echo; wc -w < /tmp/z8en_s$S.txt; done; for S in 51 52; do echo "### 8B-ZH seed $S"; taskset -c 3 ./fwd8 ../models/bonsai8b-PQ2_0.gguf 151644 872 198 100792 114116 109080 3837 101034 104588 99377 99496 110946 99774 108008 1773 151645 198 151644 77091 198 151667 271 151668 --gen 200 --sample 0.6 0.95 20 $S 0.05 2>/dev/null | grep "^step" | awk "NR>23" | sed "s/.*top=//;s/ .*//" | tr "
" " " > /tmp/z8zh_s$S.txt; echo; wc -w < /tmp/z8zh_s$S.txt; done; echo ALL_SWEEP_DONE' 2>&1 | head -14
